info.name: Denon MC3000
info.author: Bertrand Espern, Gr33nR10t, updated for Mixxx 2.5
info.description: Full 4-deck mapping for the Denon DJ MC3000. Per-side SHIFT layer, all four MIDI channels mapped, 14-bit pitch faders, hot cues, loops, effect units, samplers and LED feedback.

option.label: Jog wheel ticks per revolution
option.description: Number of MIDI ticks the jog wheel sends for one full revolution (the encoder is specified at 2048). Lower it if scratching feels too slow (the record barely moves), raise it if it feels twitchy.

option.label: Pitch bend sensitivity
option.description: Pitch-bend strength when the wheel is turned without touching the top, or when VINYL MODE is off. Higher is stronger.

option.label: VINYL MODE on at start-up
option.description: Whether the jog wheels start in scratch mode (on) or pitch bend mode (off).

option.label: Key lock at start-up
option.description: Key lock state applied to all four decks when the mapping is loaded.

option.label: Invert pitch faders
option.description: Enable if moving the pitch fader towards "+" slows the track down.

option.label: Soft takeover for pitch faders
option.description: After switching deck, ignore the pitch fader until it reaches the tempo of the newly selected deck. This prevents tempo jumps, but the fader feels dead until it has been moved to that tempo.

option.label: CHANNEL SELECT minimum press time (ms)
option.description: DECK CHG also sends a very short (about 1 ms) press of CHANNEL SELECT A/C and B/D. Only presses held at least this long switch the deck that LOAD A/C and LOAD B/D target.

option.label: Soft takeover for gain, EQ and filter knobs
option.description: After switching deck, ignore a knob until it reaches the value of the newly selected deck. This prevents jumps, but the knob feels dead until it has been moved to that value.

option.label: Soft takeover for channel faders
option.description: Same as above, for the channel volume faders.

option.label: Effect units follow the selected deck
option.description: When switching deck (for example A to C), move the effect unit of that side to the newly selected deck if it was routed to the previous one.

option.label: Sampler volume at start-up
option.description: Volume applied to all samplers when the mapping is loaded.

option.label: Show the channel levels on the 7-segment meters
option.description: Drive the level meter LEDs of the controller.

option.label: Blink the SYNC LED near the end of the track
option.description: If disabled, the SYNC LED only shows the sync lock state.

option.label: End of track warning position
option.description: Position in the track (0.9 = 90 %) from which the SYNC LED blinks.

option.label: SAMP. button long press time (ms)
option.description: Holding a SAMP. button this long toggles loop (repeat) of that sampler. With SHIFT held, it makes the sampler the sync leader instead.

option.label: Samplers follow the sync leader
option.description: Turn sync on for every sampler when a track is loaded into it, so all samplers play at the same BPM.

option.label: Quantize samplers
option.description: Turn quantize on for every sampler when a track is loaded into it, so it starts on the beat.

option.label: Internal clock is the sync leader at start-up
option.description: Makes the internal clock the sync leader when the mapping loads, so SHIFT + a sampler knob can set the BPM of all synced samplers. A deck or sampler can still take over as leader later.

option.label: BPM at the left end of the knob
option.description: SHIFT + a sampler knob (SAMP. MODE) sets the BPM of the internal clock between this value (knob fully left) and the one below (fully right).

option.label: BPM at the right end of the knob
option.description: See above.
